method: Actual official web tool complete displayed single-provision pages independently read, after original independent preparation; no copied third-party full text in this package.

sources.ownBoundedReading: Legislation bound by the constitutional order; administration and courts bound by law. The invented model rule supplies additional case procedure, rather than pretending to reproduce a municipal statute.
Equality before law supports the supplied comparable-case standard. Actual relevant differences can justify differentiated treatment; sameness of every outcome is not claimed.
Independent court protection is available where public authority violates rights. No guarantee of successful litigation or automatic invalidity from missing information is claimed.

Buyer choice and seller necessary-cost responsibility have a limited multi-factor disproportionate-cost exception, including item value, defect importance and disadvantages of an alternative. No statutory fixed price ratio is supplied.
